# Docs-set patterns: changed paths that cannot affect compiled, tested, or
# scanned behavior. Single source for the dorny `code` leaf filter
# (.github/leaf-code-filter.yml, generated by
# `go run ./cmd/ci-gates generate-leaf-filters`) and the Go docs set
# (go/internal/cigates/docsset.go `docsSetPatterns`).
#
# One MatchGlob pattern per line, in emission order. `**` already crosses
# segments in MatchGlob, so `**/*.md` covers root-level markdown too; the
# generator still emits both `*.md` and `**/*.md` negations because
# dorny/picomatch treats a slash-free pattern as root-only.
#
# Deliberately NOT in the set: specs/** JSON (image pins feed the query-plan
# image contract), go/**, sdk/**, tests/**, and testdata/** JSON (unit tests
# and go:embed directives consume them). Lockstep test inputs
# (specs/ci-docs-lockstep-paths.txt) look like prose but stay code.
docs/**
**/*.md
*.json
docs/**/*.json
scripts/**/*.json
mkdocs.yml
.github/**/*.md
.agents/**
